headers:
1. PROVIDE LEGRAND CHIEFPAC MONITOR BOX MODEL #PAC526FB4 (OR
APPROVED EQUAL). PROVIDE WITH ADDITIONAL DATA OUTLET AS SHOWN.
PROVIDE ALL MOUNTING HARDWARE, DEVICES AND COVERPLATE FOR A
COMPLETE INSTALLATION. PROVIDE 3/4"C. FOR POWER WIRING AND 1"C.
WITH PULL WIRE FOR DATA CABLING. 1"C. DATA CONDUIT TO BE STUBBED UP
TO ACCESSIBLE CEILING SPACE ABOVE.
2. PROVIDE POWER AND FINAL CONNECTIONS TO AUTOMATIC DOOR
OPERATOR AND PUSH PLATES FOR A COMPLETE INSTALLATION.
3. TWO(2) 4" CONDUITS STUBBED 6" ABOVE FLOOR. PROVIDE EACH CONDUIT
WITH ONE(1) 1 1/4" INNERDUCT AND 24SM FIBER IN INNERDUCT. REFER TO
SITE PLAN E100 AND SHEET E910.
4. SIX(6) 4" CONDUIT RISERS UP TO LEVEL2/ 3/4 FOR HORIZONTAL CABLING.
HORIZONTAL CABLING TO WATERFALL FROM RISERS INTO CABLE TRAY
SECTION.
5. 12"X4" CABLE TRAY SECTION IN ABOVE ACCESSIBLE CEILING.
6. THREE(3) 44EZPATHS MOUNTED ABOVE CABLE RUNWAY IN IDF.
7. PROVIDE LOW VOLTAGE CONTROL TRANSFORMER, POWER AND FINAL
CONNECTION TO SMOKE CURTAIN PER MANUFACTURERS WRITTEN
INSTRUCTIONS FOR A COMPLETE AND FULLY FUNCTIONING INSTALLATION.
REFER TO FIRE ALARM DRAWINGS FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION.
8. PROVIDE POWER MODULE SWITCH FOR PASSENGER ELEVATOR. PROVIDE
ALL FINAL CONNECTIONS TO ELEVATOR CONTROLLER PER MANUFACTURERS
WRITTEN INSTRUCTIONS. PROVIDE FEEDER WIRING FROM PANEL 1NH1, (3) #
3, (1) #8G, 1" CONDUIT. BUSSMAN PS SERIES, 480 VOLT, 3 PHASE. BASIS OF
DESIGN IS FOR A 40HP, 480V, 3PH MOTOR, VERIFY EXACT MOTOR SIZE WITH
ELEVATOR MANUFACTURER SELECTED.
9. PROVIDE 120V, 30A, FUSED DISCONNECT SWITCH WITH 15A FUSES FOR
ELEVATOR CAB LIGHTING AND POWER. COORDINATE CONNECTION WITH
ELEVATOR INSTALLER. PROVIDE (2) #12, (1) #12 G, 3/4" C.
10. PROVIDE POWER AND FINAL CONNECTION TO SUMP PUMP CONTROLLER,
SUMP PUMP AND DISCONNECTS FOR A COMPLETE INSTALLATION. INSTALL
PER MANUFACTURERS WRITTEN INSTRUCTIONS. REFER TO SUMP PUMP
DETAIL 15 ON SHEET P501 FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION.
11. VFD TO CONTROL (4) SUPPLY FANS, REFER TO MECHANICAL SCHEDULES
AND EQUIPMENT DATA SCHEDULE FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION.
12. VFD TO CONTROL (6) RETURN FANS, REFER TO MECHANICAL SCHEDULES
AND EQUIPMENT DATA SCHEDULE FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION.
13. PROVIDE POWER TO AHU LIGHTS, RECEPTACLE(S) AND MISC. 120V POWER.
